```{r}
#import needed libraries
library(tidyverse)
library(openxlsx)
library(sandwich)
library(lmtest)
library(survey)
```


```{r}
anes_ts <- read_csv('~/Documents/GitHub/es32033-dissertation/data/anes/anes_timeseries_cdf_csv_20260205.csv')
```
```{r}
VCF9096_2024_fix <- read.xlsx('~/Documents/GitHub/es32033-dissertation/data/anes/VCF9096_2024.xlsx')
anes_ts <- anes_ts %>% rows_update(
  VCF9096_2024_fix, by = c('VCF0004', 'VCF0006'), unmatched = 'error'
)
```



```{r}
var_rename <- c(study_year = 'VCF0004',
  case_id = 'VCF0006',
  weighting = 'VCF0009z',
  turnout = 'VCF0702',
  age = 'VCF0101',
  gender = 'VCF0104',
  education = 'VCF0140',
  inc_bracket = 'VCF0114',
  libconself = 'VCF0803',
  libcondem = 'VCF9088',
  libconrep = 'VCF9096')

anes_ts_transformed <- anes_ts %>% rename(all_of(var_rename)) %>%
  mutate(
        distance_from_dem_libcon = abs(libconself - libcondem),
        distance_from_rep_libcon = abs(libconself - libconrep),
        distance_from_closest = pmin(distance_from_dem_libcon, distance_from_rep_libcon),
        distance_from_furthest = pmax(distance_from_dem_libcon, distance_from_rep_libcon),
        
        # assign 1 to graduates and 0 to non graduates - 6 is the level assigned to grads in the 6 category education var
        graduate = ifelse(education == 6, 1, 0),
        turnout = case_when(
          turnout == 1 ~ 0,
          turnout == 2 ~ 1,
          .default = NA
          ),
        # 1 corresponds to male, 2 to female
        gender = factor(gender, levels = c(1, 2), labels = c('Male', 'Female')),
        # household income is divided into percentiles
        inc_bracket = factor(inc_bracket, levels = 1:5, labels = c('0-16_percentile', '17-33_percentile',   
                                                                   '34-67_percentile', '68-95_percentile',
                                                                   '96-100_percentile'))
        )
  


```

```{r}
# PSU variable not available for ts data - recalculate 24 to estimate effect
des_24 <- svydesign(
  ids = ~1,
  weights = ~ weighting,
  data = anes_ts_transformed
)

des_24_full <- des_24 %>% subset(age >= 1 & 
                                 !is.na(gender) & 
                                 study_year == 2024 & 
                                 !is.na(inc_bracket) &
                                 between(education, 0, 6) &
                                 between(libconself, 1, 7) &
                                 between(libconrep, 1, 7) &
                                 between(libcondem, 1, 7) &
                                 between(turnout, 0, 1))
                                 
```

```{r}
comparison_lpm <- svyglm(turnout ~ distance_from_closest + distance_from_furthest + graduate + inc_bracket + gender + age + I(age^2), design = des_24_full)
summary(full_lpm)
summary(comparison_lpm)

```
